note: Commander traits of common/unit_leader/00_traits.txt. The engine keys stay (the engine awards terrain and skill-gain traits by name, the characters spec names them, the trait window reads them); names, text and values are Erdae's. No tank, aeroplane, submarine, carrier or specialist-advisor-of-the-old-ladder trait remains. Operative traits keep their engine keys and modifiers (section 8.3). Terrain blocks (desert, forest...) are validated against the terrain names of the game, not against the modifier documentation.
tagFileComment: Comment-only: the vanilla file held traits for vanilla countries. The same file name overrides it so that none of them loads.

adviserMap._note: Which chief family a unit-leader trait converts to when the commander is made a chief (slot and the three advisor traits). Families are zin_chief_<family>_<tier>.

traits.name: Greybeard
traits.desc: §LHe has seen many seasons and fears few of them. He will not make trouble, and will not be hurried.§!

traits.name: Far-Sighted
traits.desc: §LHe sees three battles ahead, and has usually drawn the second one on a table.§!

traits.name: Hard Planner
traits.desc: §LOnce a plan is made he keeps it, and the road to change it is long.§!

traits.name: Court Favourite
traits.desc: §LHis uncle sits near the throne, and he is promoted before he is proven.§!

traits.name: Fearless
traits.desc: §LHe is first through the gate, and his men follow because they must.§!

traits.name: Hero of the Songs
traits.desc: §LThe singers have given him a name, and now every lord wants him at his table.§!

traits.name: Seasoned Captain
traits.desc: §LHe has served in every garrison from the Wall to the coast, and rose one step at a time.§!

traits.name: Careful
traits.desc: §LHe counts his men before and after, and prefers the count to be the same.§!

traits.name: Headlong
traits.desc: §LHe has never waited for the second rank, and has the scars to prove it.§!

traits.name: Beloved of the Singers
traits.desc: §LThe taverns sing of him; the Council cannot easily replace so loved a man.§!

traits.name: Stern Master
traits.desc: §LHis hosts are drilled until they hate him, and they win.§!

traits.name: Foot Captain
traits.desc: §LBorn in the ranks, he thinks like a soldier on his own two feet.§!

traits.name: Rider Captain
traits.desc: §LHe has ridden since he could stand, and counts distance in horses.§!

traits.name: Sapper Captain
traits.desc: §LTrained among the wall-builders, he sees every field as a problem of stone and earth.§!

traits.name: Master of Stores
traits.desc: §LThe sacks are never late, and never early; they arrive on the day he said.§!

traits.name: Drive of the Host
traits.desc: §LThe host moves as one body and does not stop to ask why.§!

traits.name: Stand of the Host
traits.desc: §LThe host digs first, and talks of marching afterward.§!

traits.name: Swift Planner
traits.desc: §LThe plan is on the table before the messengers have unsaddled.§!

traits.name: Patient Planner
traits.desc: §LHe will spend a winter on a plan, and the plan will not fail.§!

traits.name: Unyielding Warden
traits.desc: §LHe has never been moved from a post he chose to hold.§!

traits.name: Spear-Lord
traits.desc: §LHe counts a day without a charge as a day wasted.§!

traits.name: Master of Banners
traits.desc: §LEvery company knows where to find its banner, and the rolls are never wrong.§!

traits.name: Rallying Voice
traits.desc: §LWhen he rides down the line, even the dying sit up straighter.§!

traits.name: Trusting Lord
traits.desc: §LHe gives his captains their orders and then stays out of their way.§!

traits.name: Council Hand
traits.desc: §LHe works from the plan the Council sent and keeps it clean.§!

traits.name: Rider-Lord
traits.desc: §LHe commands from the saddle and does not recognise a field too wide.§!

traits.name: Foot-Lord
traits.desc: §LHe has grown old among the pike-hedges and knows how they hold.§!

traits.name: Staff Master
traits.desc: §LGive him a hundred hosts and he will find the road for each.§!

traits.name: Cunning
traits.desc: §LHe is never where the enemy looks, and always where they have not.§!

traits.name: Winter-Born
traits.desc: §LHe grew up under snow and moves as easily over it as other men on a road.§!

traits.name: Wayfarer
traits.desc: §LHe is at home wherever his host has to lie that night.§!

traits.name: Frost-Walker
traits.desc: §LThe cold does not slow his host; it slows only the enemy's.§!

traits.name: Wall-Breaker
traits.desc: §LTo him a river is a ditch with an opinion, and a wall is a delay.§!

traits.name: Night-Raider
traits.desc: §LHis hosts march when others sleep and fight when others cannot see.§!

traits.name: Sand-Runner
traits.desc: §LHe has crossed the dry lands more times than the guides.§!

traits.name: Fen-Runner
traits.desc: §LThe marsh is his road; he knows where it holds.§!

traits.name: Mountain-Walker
traits.desc: §LHe climbs where goats fear to go, and expects his host to follow.§!

traits.name: Hill-Fighter
traits.desc: §LHe always wants the high ground, and generally gets it.§!

traits.name: Jungle-Wise
traits.desc: §LHe finds paths in the green gloom that the maps do not show.§!

traits.name: Woodsman
traits.desc: §LThe forest hides his hosts and gives them up only when he chooses.§!

traits.name: Wall-Stormer
traits.desc: §LWalled towns are the work he knows best, and the slowest.§!

traits.name: Sea-Lander
traits.desc: §LHe has stepped out of more boats into more surf than any other captain.§!

traits.name: Master of Riders
traits.desc: §LHis riders hold a line as well as they break one.§!

traits.name: Siege-Breaker
traits.desc: §LNo wall has held against him longer than the engines took to arrive.§!

traits.name: Battlefield Gleaner
traits.desc: §LNothing is left on a field after his host has passed.§!

traits.name: Master of Foot
traits.desc: §LHe trains pikes and axes until the hedge moves like one animal.§!

traits.name: Lie-in-Wait
traits.desc: §LThe road he picks always has a ditch beside it, and a company in it.§!

traits.name: Master of Landings
traits.desc: §LHis landings take supper ashore the first night, and not a day later.§!

traits.name: Friend of the Fleet
traits.desc: §LThe fleet is happy to lay its great engines at his orders.§!

traits.name: Harrier
traits.desc: §LHe pricks the enemy line a hundred times and never gives it a target.§!

traits.name: Improviser
traits.desc: §LGive him rope, timber and a night, and he will give you a crossing.§!

traits.name: Hedge-Fighter
traits.desc: §LHe is behind a hedge before the enemy knows there was a road.§!

traits.name: Strait-Runner
traits.desc: §LNo closed harbour has stopped him, and no chain was ever taut enough.§!

traits.name: Lookout
traits.desc: §LHe sees sails at the edge of the world and knows whose they are.§!

traits.name: Fleet Guardian
traits.desc: §LThe merchant fleets sleep easier when he is on the lane.§!

traits.name: Master Tactician
traits.desc: §LHe stands the fleet where the wind and the sun are his.§!

traits.name: Iron-Hull
traits.desc: §LThe great hulls take blows for him, and he takes none himself.§!

traits.name: Master of Fog
traits.desc: §LHe sails in the mist the others avoid, and finds the harbour first.§!

traits.name: Lone Raider
traits.desc: §LHe sails with a few hulls and a long list of grudges.§!

traits.name: Sweep-Master
traits.desc: §LHis ships fan out like fingers, and the sea gives up what it hides.§!

traits.name: Shore-Breaker
traits.desc: §LHe lays the fleet close to shore and does not mind the answer.§!

traits.name: Master of Great Hulls
traits.desc: §LHe has commanded nothing smaller than a great warship in thirty years.§!

traits.name: Careful Sea-Lord
traits.desc: §LHe brings every hull home and thinks that the best victory.§!

traits.name: Fog-Bank Master
traits.desc: §LWhen the day goes ill, he is gone into the grey.§!

traits.name: True Eye
traits.desc: §LEvery shot he orders seems to find a seam.§!

traits.name: Hull-Saver
traits.desc: §LA ship that should have sunk is still afloat, and her captain has his name.§!

traits.name: Ice-Sea Hand
traits.desc: §LHe sails among floes as if they were quays.§!

traits.name: Fjord Fighter
traits.desc: §LHe fights between cliffs and knows each echo.§!

traits.name: Deep-Water Master
traits.desc: §LHe has crossed the open sea so often that land seems a nuisance.§!

traits.name: Coast-Wise
traits.desc: §LHe knows every shoal between here and the border.§!

traits.name: Old Salt
traits.desc: §LHe commands as his master did, and sees no reason to learn a new knot.§!

traits.name: Courteous Captain
traits.desc: §LHe spares the defeated, and the defeated remember it.§!

traits.name: Engine-Layer
traits.desc: §LHe drills his crews at the great arbalests until they can hit a gull.§!

traits.name: Short-Cutter
traits.desc: §LHe saves time on the rigging and ships take more damage for it.§!

traits.name: Shipwright-Captain
traits.desc: §LHe started in the yard and still checks the planking.§!

traits.name: Harbour Hero
traits.desc: §LThe quays cheer when he sails, and his crews fight for the cheer.§!

traits.name: Daring
traits.desc: §LHe sails faster than he should, and hits harder than he ought.§!

traits.name: Lifelong Mariner
traits.desc: §LHe has served in every ship of the fleet and learned from each of them.§!

traits.name: Friend of the Great Hulls
traits.desc: §LHe trusts the great hull above all, and little else at sea.§!

traits.name: Sour Tongue
traits.desc: §LHis captains sail slow to reach him, and arrive in worse humour.§!

traits.name: Faint-Hearted
traits.desc: §LHe finds a reason to turn at the first sight of a larger fleet.§!

traits.name: Sea-Born
traits.desc: §LHis father, grandfather and his father before him were sea-lords.§!

traits.name: Knife-Hand
traits.desc: Skilled in quiet violence. Fewer eyes on the agent, and cleaner thefts of ciphers.

traits.name: Honeyed Tongue
traits.desc: Few doors stay closed to a fair word and a fair face.

traits.name: Gate-Walker
traits.desc: Gets into households, muster rolls and ships without being asked who he is.

traits.name: Questioner
traits.desc: Draws the truth out of captured agents, patiently and without noise.

traits.name: Many Tongues
traits.desc: Speaks as a native in every court he serves in.
traits.gxl:
NOT = { operative_leader_mission = no_mission }
NOT = { has_nationality = FROM }

traits.name: Turncoat
traits.desc: Serves two lords, and tells each only what the other would tell him.

traits.name: Hard to Break
traits.desc: The questioner's patience will run out before this agent's silence does.

traits.name: Lock-Wise
traits.desc: No chest, plan-case or cipher-book stays shut for long.

traits.name: Courtier's Grace
traits.desc: Sits at the lord's table and is soon asked for his opinion on the price of grain.

traits.name: Pulpit Voice
traits.desc: Draws a crowd in any market, and sends it home with a new opinion.

traits.name: Slips the Chains
traits.desc: Won by an agent who has walked out of a locked cell.

traits.name: Fire-Setter
traits.desc: Knows which beam to burn and which to leave.

traits.name: Ailing
traits.desc: A fever has laid him low. He cannot command at full strength until it breaks.

traits.name: Hurt
traits.desc: Hurt in the field. He still gives orders, but cannot ride or call the abilities of the camp.

traits.name: Newly Posted
traits.desc: Just given a new command; he does not yet know his captains.

traits.name: Sullen
traits.desc: Passed over for a post he thought his own. His heart is not in the work.

traits.name: Disgraced
traits.desc: Lowered in rank for some failure, and still smarting.

traits.name: Newly Raised
traits.desc: A new rank sits awkwardly for the first season.

traits.name: Heartened
traits.desc: A recent victory has lifted him and his hosts.

traits.name: Captain in Exile
traits.desc: A captain without a realm, who leads the hosts of his fallen house.

tooltips.ZIN_UNYIELDING_TT: Raises the chance of a successful counterattack.
tooltips.ZIN_ASSAULT_TT: Raises the chance of a successful assault and shock.
tooltips.ZIN_IMPROVISER_TT: +10% movement speed in every kind of country.
tooltips.ZIN_NEEDS_TERRAIN_TT: Needs at least one terrain trait.
tooltips.ZIN_XP_PLANS_TT: Gains experience while the host follows a campaign plan.
tooltips.ZIN_XP_RIDERS_TT: Gains experience while more than 40% of the host rides.
tooltips.ZIN_XP_FOOT_TT: Gains experience while more than 80% of the host is foot.
tooltips.ZIN_XP_STAFF_TT: Gains experience while commanding a very large force.
tooltips.ZIN_XP_FLANK_TT: Gains experience by flanking the enemy, or being flanked.
tooltips.ZIN_XP_WALLS_TT: Gains experience at forts and river crossings.
tooltips.ZIN_XP_HARSH_TT: Gains experience in great cold, great heat or sea landings.
tooltips.ZIN_XP_FAST_SHIP_TT: Gains experience while commanding a very fast ship.
tooltips.ZIN_XP_SPOTTING_TT: Gains experience by sighting the enemy.
tooltips.ZIN_XP_SCREENS_TT: Gains experience while galleys screen the fleet.
tooltips.ZIN_XP_WINNING_TT: Gains experience while winning a battle.
tooltips.ZIN_XP_GREAT_HULLS_TT: Gains experience in battles with great warships.
